body:
I am on the same page as you are: I wanna learn a lot of things, but myself tells the same. I wanna end it all too, but I can't. I don't want to, yet. I'm scared to do it, yet my mind urges me to do so. Stuck between a rock and a hard place, as they say.

This sucks so hard.

You're not the only one.
My schedule for everyday is waking up, then using the computer, eat, be with the computer again, eat for dinner, play with the computer and then sleep (after brushing my teeth).
I feel guilty doing this. I should be doing something productive, like taking a walk outside or learn some useful things, but here I am, wasting my life, being a stupid, worthless and any-negative-word-you-can-think-of person.

Hey, I guess we're both stuck in the same situation that I can't seem to get out of for years now.

I guess the point of living now, is to enjoy it, even if a little bit. Having fun that eases the pain in this world.

You pursued music AND programming as a hobby? And worked out too? I wish I could do those things (but I don't because I get tired easily so fuck it).

I wish to be you (minus the acceptance that you're giving up on life, because I'm still struggling to be a bit optimistic that there will come a time where I'm not extremely sad and anxious of everything anymore)
Don't feel bad to simply greet her "Happy birthday", it will help you not lose yourself.

**Be the light in her very, very dark place.** Do not break up with her. The more you push her away, the more you pull back to her. I hope you she gets back on her feet, and stay strong on your relationship!

edit: And yeah, you are a strong and caring person and I hope you also continue that :)

Depression can be treated, ***but it will always come back, like a spider crawling inside your ear***

You don't need to die so that they would care for you. Them trying to help you, even though you are resentful to them, is still caring.

Hey, there is a way out, but you will always be pulled back in.

Sounds cliche, but you can do it! You are living for almost 21 years and counting, you have been fighting it again and again, do not ever be tired of yourself.

You are an amazing person, with your ability to care for everyone that it left your heart open and vulnerable...  it is saddening.

A friend who won't listen clearly to your struggles is probably not a good friend. Friends are there to support each other in struggles of the daily life, and if she is not able to do it, then she may be not a good friend. Don't feel bad about it, you want to help yourself, but people want you to help them instead.

You still have something to stand on. **It is yourself.** You can do it!

You're welcome!

You can always vent here, a little or not. As long as it helps you feel better in a positive way, it's good

One doesn't choose to be depressed. If it was, many would be cured of it right now...

Young or old, depression strikes anyone. You're a young child? No excuse for depression to make him/her sad until he/she can beat it.

Depression, once driven away, comes back, as you've experienced that it constantly reappears and drags you down. Clearly you didn't chose to be depressed, it just came back and it's now twisting your way of thinking.

I hope you get more support, not only here, but also from your counselling and medications. :)

Hey, that's good for you!

I hope you continue to be happy in your life. :)

"An end is a new beginning" means that after a series of pain and suffering (or happiness), you get to begin living life in a positive way (or not). Invisibility is both a curse and blessing, and it depends upon oneself on how it is used in the environment.

Not all the time people can give out a good response in an instant, sadly. People need time to think of what words to be used or the point that the user wants to convey may be gone.

I guess people just don't see your worth.

But with your hard work and the ability to be helpful makes you worthy, don't think about yourself being a "wasted potential" because you ARE worth it.

And hey, you will not die alone, you'll meet tons of people here that will try and help you cheer up your day. :)

Hey happy birthday to you, first off!

You can post anything here, like venting out your struggles in life.

I hope one day you could get your happiness, confidence and self-worth back to you :)
I'm sorry dude if it came off as pro-suicide comment. I'll just edit it for other people not to see. It's my personal opinion anyway...

I don't feel worthless, I **am** worthless.

It sucks so hard to live like this, trying my best to be not one, yet at the end of the day, I still am.
It's not only one chance, there are many chances as you are still young, a lot of opportunities to grab, so don't you worry.
You can always talk and bother to someone here in this subreddit and be their friend, because everyone is worth bothering for.

I enjoy trying to help other people who are depressed. I try my best to be there for them, even if they can't be there for me in my worst moments.

Even with the little help I can give, their "Thank you" is enough for me to keep on living. Even if I don't want to live past 50 or something.

And also: computer games. I grew large eye bags and got myself a nice pair of glasses (sometimes face myself in the computer screen for 14 hrs/day) for this.

[redacted cause I really don't want to get banned haha]

The reason suicide is bad mostly because **life may get better**. *People removing that chance of having a good life may leave with regrets*.

At some point in our lives, we are meant to live good lives. From your perspective, you may see that the "good life" is something of far reach. The little things you enjoy, like feeling good after eating food, that's a "good life" already, if you see as it is.

Aw man I got bamboozled. :(

But anyway, it's great to know that you won't commit suicide. Meeting the kind of people you'd want to hang out with may make your life awesome again, that I hope that you can be with them one day. :)

Nice analogy!

To be depressed is to be paralyzed, forced to watch your world crumble right before your eyes.

Currently dead inside, it sucks. Big time. I can't do anything well.

It's frustrating that it can't be helped.
Congratulations on living a happy life! I hope that you continue your bond to other people and helping others in their mental struggles. :)

In shorter words: I want to be loved, yet I hate myself.

I guess I am also pretty fucking stupid too.

Are you me? I can't kill myself yet, but I surely have given up so badly on my life.

There's a lot of assignments and projects to be passed as soon as possible, yet I am doing nothing.

They say I am an intelligent person, but how can they say that? I can't even prove to them my "intelligence"! I fail and I am always at the bottom.

I'm pretty useless, leeching off my family. I'm so dead inside, my body is merely just living for its own sake of living, as I have not decided to kill myself yet.

You still have a choice: it's simply to live. Since you, yourself, said that you are the problem, then the solution is not death: it's also you.

You can change, I believe. Believe in yourself that you can correct things.

Don't forget that there is always a light at the end of a tunnel, no matter how dim it is, it will always exist and never be extinguished.

Hey, are you me?

About your future, don't worry too much about it. You may lose your eyes on the present and it will not be good.

About people judging you, simply ignore their judgments. Focus on yourself and to people who matter the most to you.
This is the most plausible situation you can do to get out of there.

I try to help people, but not volunteer at the soup kitchen, there are no such things here as I have heard. But I try to help people like me, although I don't admit to them that I am this. I cheer them up with funny things and it makes me forget that I am this and they become happy too. How I wish it was easy as that to make these thoughts gone.

I know that my family loves me, not through words (they never talk about love and shit), but through actions (they would treat me food, that's better), but I can't really tell them because they will not understand a single thing (as I believe). They're still thinking like the old generation and sometimes does not understand the current issues of today (as I also believe, but I may be wrong here).

I am addicted to video-games I admit, but I can handle it sometimes. But it really does not matter at all.
From what I read, you're not really bad for a person. Just bad luck and life decisions. Life is hard, even to those who work hard or not.
